import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
    static long[][] ans = new long[30][30];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 40; j++) {
                if (j > i) {
                    ncr[i][j] = 0;
                    continue;
                }
                if (j == 0 || j == i) {
                    ncr[i][j] = 1;
                    continue;
                }
                ncr[i][j] = ncr[i - 1][j - 1] + ncr[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long R = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long C = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        String str = br.readLine();
        long n = R + C;
        long[][] blockarea = new long[n][n];
        long[][] totalarea = new long[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (long a = 0; a < n; a++) {
            for (long b = 0; b < n; b++) {
                blockarea[(int) a][(int) b] = ncr[(int) a][(int) R - 1] * ncr[(int) b][(int) R - 1];
            }
        }
        long[][] revarea = new long[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (long a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (long b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                totalarea[(int) a][(int) b] = 0;
                if (a == 0 || b == 0) continue;
                totalarea[(int) a][(int) b] = totalarea[(int) a][(int) b - 1] + totalarea[(int) a - 1][(int) b] - totalarea[(int) a - 1][(int) b - 1];
                totalarea[(int) a][(int) b] += blockarea[(int) a - 1][(int) b - 1];
            }
        }
        for (long a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (long b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                revarea[(int) a][(int) b] = totalarea[(int) n][(int) n] - totalarea[(int) n - (int) a][(int) n]
                        - totalarea[(int) n][(int) n - (int) b] + totalarea[(int) n - (int) a][(int) n - (int) b];
            }
        }

        long d = Math.min(2 * n - 1, n);

        Map<Long, Long>[] dp = new HashMap[(int) n + 1];
        Map<Long, Long>[] bp = new HashMap[(int) n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            dp[i] = new HashMap<>();
            bp[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }
        dp[0].put(0L, 1L);
        bp[0].put(0L, 1L);

        long best = ans[(int) R][(int) C];
        long m1 = (-best + totalarea[(int) n][(int) n]) / 2;
        long m2 = totalarea[(int) n][(int) n] - m1;
        long bestfreq = 0;

        for (long x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            for (long y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt((int) x + (int) y) != 'B') {
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> it : dp[(int) x][(int) y].entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = it.getKey() + totalarea[(int) n][(int) y + 1] - totalarea[(int) x][(int) y + 1];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        dp[(int) x][(int) y + 1].put(it.getKey(), dp[(int) x][(int) y].get(it.getKey()) + it.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt(n - (int) x + n - (int) y - 1) != 'B') {
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> it : bp[(int) x][(int) y].entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = totalarea[(int) n][(int) n] - it.getKey() - totalarea[(int) n - (int) x][(int) n - (int) y - 1];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        bp[(int) x][(int) y + 1].put(it.getKey(), bp[(int) x][(int) y].get(it.getKey()) + it.getValue());
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == n) continue;
            for (long y = 0; y <= n; y++) {

                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt((int) x + (int) y) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[(int) x + 1][(int) y] - totalarea[(int) x][(int) y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> it : dp[(int) x][(int) y].entrySet()) {
                        long c = it.getKey() + newarea;
                        long area2 = totalarea[(int) x + 1][(int) n] - c;
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        dp[(int) x + 1][(int) y].put(c + newarea, dp[(int) x][(int) y].get(it.getKey()) + it.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt(n - (int) x + n - (int) y - 1) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[(int) n - (int) x][(int) n - (int) y] - totalarea[(int) n - (int) x - 1][(int) n - (int) y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> it : bp[(int) x][(int) y].entrySet()) {
                        if (it.getKey() + newarea > m2) continue;
                        bp[(int) x + 1][(int) y].put(it.getKey() + newarea, bp[(int) x][(int) y].get(it.getKey()) + it.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= d) dp[(int) x].clear();
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d) bp[(int) x].clear();
            }

        }

        for (long x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            long y = d - x;
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> it : dp[(int) x][(int) y].entrySet()) {
                long c = it.getKey();
                long freq = it.getValue();
                // bp[n-x][n-y]
                bestfreq += freq * bp[(int) n - (int) x][(int) n - (int) y].getOrDefault(m1 - c, 0L);
                if (m1 != m2) bestfreq += freq * bp[(int) n - (int) x][(int) n - (int) y].getOrDefault(m2 - c, 0L);

            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
